scores.claim_text: DoW $1.0B convertible preferred anchor investment in MSL business; MSL IPO planned 2H 2026 (announced Jan 13, 2026).
scores.M_check: Mode A: sec_filings.list_filings_by_form(8-K). Mode B: insider_vs_calendar.query_insider_sales_near_budget_events(cik='0000202058', window_days=14, start_date='2024-01-01', end_date='2026-05-20').
scores.M_value: Mode A: 8 8-Ks filed between 2026-01 and 2026-05-12 — normal disclosure cadence around the DoW transaction. Mode B: 57 Form-4s, 26 sales lookback $88.7M total, 5 proximate to budget events ($2.1M), but only 1 DISCRETIONARY proximate sale (Rakita 2026-05-05 $677K, 7 days after FY27 J-Book release showing Tranche 3 Transport Layer unfunded for second year). All other proximate sales are code 'F' (tax-withholding on vest), i.e. NON-discretionary. Signal: PROXIMATE_DISCRETIONARY but NOT CLUSTERED_DISCRETIONARY (1 owner, 1 small sale).
scores.interpretation: PASS on the equity event itself. Mode B yields a YELLOW-FLAG worth noting in the narrative: SAS President Melanie Rakita executed a single discretionary sale 7 days after FY27 J-Book confirmed LHX's SDA Tranche 3 Transport Layer (a major LHX SAS program) was unfunded for the second consecutive year. This is the IONQ pattern in miniature, but at $677K on a $50B-cap company it is well below the SEVE threshold for material insider clustering. Net call: PASS with documented watch.
